desc.zh: 一个事件越不可能，发生时带来的信息越大：惊奇度 I = −log₂p，概率每减半恰好 +1 bit。熵是平均惊奇——二元熵曲线在公平的 p = ½ 登顶 1 bit；符号源沿时间轴流出惊奇脉冲，运行平均线逐渐贴上 H 线。最后逐步重演 Huffman 建树：高频短码、低频长码，平均码长永远压不到熵线之下——熵是无损压缩的极限。
desc.en: The less likely an event, the more information it carries: surprise I = −log₂p, exactly +1 bit per halving of p. Entropy is average surprise — the binary entropy curve peaks at 1 bit at the fair p = ½; a symbol source streams surprise pulses while the running average settles onto the H line. Then replay Huffman construction step by step: short codes for frequent symbols, long for rare ones, and the mean code length never drops below the entropy line — entropy is the limit of lossless compression.

title.zh: 霍夫曼编码 · 从文本到比特
title.en: Huffman Coding · From Text to Bits

desc.zh: 输入任意一段文字，看它一步步变成比特流。编码器读不懂含义，它只数数：字符沿时间轴流走，只剩下一排频次柱。接着每一拍合并两个最小权重的节点，树自底向上长出来——越罕见的字符越早被合并，在树里沉得越深；高频字符挂得浅，码字就短。最后逐字编码，码流像示波器上的方波流出，每个字符占据的宽度就是它的代价。关掉码字分组，所有分隔标记消失，解码行依然一字不差——这就是前缀码的精髓：没有任何码字是另一个码字的前缀。速度可调、可暂停，每一步合并与每一个码字都在面板里逐条列出。
desc.en: Type any text and watch it turn into bits, one step at a time. The encoder never reads meaning — it only counts: characters stream away along the time axis and all that remains is a row of frequency bars. Then each tick merges the two lightest nodes and the tree grows bottom-up — the rarer a character, the earlier it merges and the deeper it sinks, while frequent ones hang shallow and get short codewords. Finally the text is encoded character by character, the bitstream unrolling like a square wave where the width each character occupies is exactly its cost. Switch off the codeword groups and every separator vanishes, yet the decoded row still recovers the text exactly — that is the heart of a prefix code: no codeword is a prefix of another. Speed is adjustable, playback pauses, and every merge and every codeword is logged in the panel.

title.zh: 维度的阶梯 · 从点到分形
title.en: The Ladder of Dimension · From a Point to Fractals

desc.zh: 把一个东西放大 r 倍，需要 N 份原件才填得满它——维数就定义为 d = log N / log r。点是 0、线是 1、方是 2、立方是 3，而 Cantor 集是 0.631、Koch 曲线是 1.262、Sierpiński 三角是 1.585：切到 log-log 侧视，七条射线扇形张开，非整数的斜率明明白白夹在整数之间，分形不再是怪东西，只是斜率不凑整。维数还可以量出来：用边长 ε 的盒子覆盖曲线数格子，ε 缩小一半时格子数翻多少倍，log-log 上的斜率就是多少——圆给出 1、圆盘给出 2、Koch 给出 1.23，测法自证可信。再往深一层，豪斯多夫测度回答了这个指数为什么非它不可：Σ(diam)^d 在临界维数处从 ∞ 一步跌到 0，而允许大小不一的覆盖取下确界，正是它与只用同尺寸盒子的闵可夫斯基维数的分别。最后一页把同一个公式推到第四维：超立方体的「立方体套立方体」不是套着的，那只是四维在三维里投下的影子。
desc.en: Scale a thing by r and it takes N copies to fill it again — that is the definition: d = log N / log r. A point gives 0, a line 1, a square 2, a cube 3 — and the Cantor set gives 0.631, the Koch curve 1.262, the Sierpiński triangle 1.585. Switch to the log-log side view and seven rays fan out, the non-integer slopes visibly wedged between the integer ones: a fractal is not a strange object, only a slope that does not land on a whole number. Dimension can also be measured rather than derived: cover a curve with boxes of side ε and count them, and the factor by which the count grows as ε halves is the slope on the log-log plot — a circle gives 1, a disk gives 2, the Koch curve gives 1.23, so the method vouches for itself. One layer deeper, the Hausdorff measure shows why that exponent is forced: Σ(diam)^d falls from ∞ to 0 in a single step at the critical dimension, and allowing covers of unequal size and taking the infimum is exactly what separates it from the equal-box Minkowski dimension. The last tab pushes the same formula into the fourth dimension: the tesseract's cube-inside-a-cube is not nested at all — it is the shadow four dimensions cast into three.

title.zh: 光锥 · 四维时空的因果结构
title.en: The Light Cone · Causal Structure of Spacetime

desc.zh: 锥不是画出来的，是一次闪光扫出来的：从原点发出的光在每个时刻是半径 r = ct 的圆，圆一边长大一边沿 ct 上升，扫出的曲面就是光锥——取 c = 1，母线斜率恰好是 1，45° 于是成了结论而不是约定。打开「伽利略速度叠加」对照：按速度叠加，运动观察者的闪光圆心会跟着他跑，锥歪了；而光速对所有人一样意味着圆心钉死在原点，锥纹丝不动，让步的只能是「同时」。由此 (ct)² − r² = 0 对人人成立，推广开就是不变间隔 s² = (ct)² − x² − y²。往下三页把这条线索走完：s² 的符号把时空切成绝对未来、绝对过去与「别处」；三条世界线上的固有时钟点显示闵可夫斯基几何里三角不等式是反的——直的那条最长，折返得越急、回来时钟走得越少；拉动 β，坐标轴与同时面向光锥对称剪切，两个同时的事件分出先后而因果毫发无伤；最后 s² 的等值面是双曲面，推动就是沿双曲线的双曲旋转，光锥则是那条圆心退到无穷远的「圆」。
desc.en: The cone is not drawn — it is swept. Light leaving the origin is a circle of radius r = ct at every instant, and as that circle grows it rises along ct, sweeping out the light cone. With c = 1 the generators have slope exactly 1, so 45° is a conclusion rather than a convention. Switch on the Galilean control: under velocity addition a moving observer's flash circle drifts along with them and the cone tips over, whereas the constancy of c pins the centre at the origin and the cone does not budge — what has to give is simultaneity. Since (ct)² − r² = 0 then holds for everyone, extending it off the cone gives the invariant interval s² = (ct)² − x² − y². Three further tabs follow that thread: the sign of s² cuts spacetime into absolute future, absolute past and elsewhere; proper-time ticks on three worldlines show the triangle inequality running backwards in Minkowski geometry — the straight one is longest, and the sharper the turnaround the less the travelling clock records; dragging β shears the axes and the planes of simultaneity symmetrically toward the cone, splitting two simultaneous events in time while causality is untouched; and finally the level sets of s² are hyperboloids, a boost is a hyperbolic rotation along them, and the light cone is the circle whose centre has receded to infinity.

title.zh: 从牛顿到闵可夫斯基 · 时空的重建
title.en: From Newton to Minkowski · Rebuilding Spacetime

desc.zh: 牛顿时空与闵可夫斯基时空的差别只有一条：有没有一个不变的速度。先看牛顿那一叠绝对同时面——伽利略变换只敢推倒世界线，水平的切片纹丝不动；再看它在哪里裂开：伽利略预言追光者测到 c−v，而实验给出一条恒定的水平线，整个相对论就是从这一条线推出来的。核心一页把那个著名的减号还原成推导：把不变量写成待定二次型 Q(ε) = (ct)² + ε(x² + y²)，只要求光的世界线落在 Q = 0 上，就得 (1+ε)(ct)² = 0，于是 ε = −1 是唯一解。拖着 ε 从 +1 走到 −1，等值面从球面变成一对水平平面、再变成双曲面，而零集从一个点变成整个 ct = 0 平面、再变成 45° 双锥——锥是同号做不到、零号也做不到的那个东西，光锥就在这里诞生。另有 ict 视角还原闵可夫斯基当年的写法：减号藏进虚数，欧氏旋转就地变成双曲旋转。最后回答那个实际问题：γ 曲线上钉着步行、客机、卫星、GPS 与 LHC 质子的真实位置，β < 0.1 时牛顿的误差不到 0.5%，β > 0.87 时相对论完全接管。
desc.en: Newtonian and Minkowski spacetime differ in exactly one thing: whether there is an invariant speed. Start with Newton's stack of absolute simultaneity slices — a Galilean transformation only dares tip the worldlines, while the horizontal slices stay dead flat. Then watch it crack: Galilean kinematics predicts a chaser measures c−v for light, and experiment returns a flat horizontal line instead — that single line is the entire input to relativity. The central tab turns the famous minus sign back into a derivation: write the invariant as an undetermined quadratic form Q(ε) = (ct)² + ε(x² + y²) and demand only that the worldline of light lie on Q = 0. That gives (1+ε)(ct)² = 0, so ε = −1 is the only solution. Drag ε from +1 down to −1 and the level sets morph from a sphere to a pair of horizontal planes to a hyperboloid, while the null set morphs from a single point to the whole ct = 0 plane to a 45° double cone — the cone is what neither matching signs nor a vanishing sign can produce, and this is where the light cone is born. An ict view restores Minkowski's own notation, hiding the minus sign inside an imaginary coordinate so that a Euclidean rotation becomes a hyperbolic one. A final tab answers the practical question: the γ curve carries real markers for walking, airliners, satellites, GPS and LHC protons — below β = 0.1 Newton is wrong by under 0.5%, above β = 0.87 relativity has taken over completely.

title.zh: 混沌双摆 · 确定性的不可预测
title.en: The Chaotic Double Pendulum · Deterministic yet Unpredictable

desc.zh: 两个双摆，同一个方程、同一台计算机，初值只差第 6 位小数。一开始它们的轨迹是一条线，看不出有两个系统；跑一阵后突然分岔，此后毫无关系。混沌不是随机——是确定性系统对初值的指数敏感。第二页把这件事量化：log δ(t) 对 t 是一条直线，斜率就是李雅普诺夫指数 λ；一族不同初值偏差的曲线彼此平行且等距，于是初值精度每多一位小数，预测时限只增加 ln10/λ 秒。这就是为什么天气预报到不了两周——不是算力不够，是指数不讲道理。第三页给出混沌的机制本身：一小段弧上的初值被拉伸成长丝、又被相空间的有界性折叠回来，反复几次扒成一团絮；只有拉伸是发散，只有折叠是周期，两者共存才是混沌。最后一页在庞加莱截面上看它怎么发生：低能量时是一圈圈干净的 KAM 环面，能量升高，环面从共振处裂开一串小岛，混沌的海从缝里渗进来——混沌不是开关，是渗透。全程只做单向推演，能量漂移常驻读数：你连模拟都算不准，正是因为它混沌。
desc.en: Two double pendulums, same equations, same computer, initial angles differing in the sixth decimal place. At first their trajectories are a single line and you cannot tell there are two systems; a while later they split, and after that they have nothing to do with each other. Chaos is not randomness — it is a deterministic system's exponential sensitivity to initial conditions. The second tab makes that quantitative: log δ(t) against t is a straight line whose slope is the Lyapunov exponent λ, and a family of curves at different initial offsets comes out parallel and evenly spaced, so each extra decimal digit of precision buys only ln10/λ more seconds of forecast. That is why weather forecasts stop at about two weeks — not for want of computing power, but because exponentials do not negotiate. The third tab shows the mechanism itself: initial conditions on a short arc are stretched into a long filament and folded back by the boundedness of phase space, over and over, until they are teased into a wisp. Stretching alone diverges, folding alone is periodic; only both together are chaos. The last tab watches it happen on a Poincaré section: at low energy, clean nested KAM tori; raise the energy and the tori break at resonances into chains of islands while a chaotic sea seeps through the cracks — chaos is not a switch, it is percolation. Everything runs forward only, and the energy drift stays on screen: you cannot even simulate it accurately, precisely because it is chaotic.

title.zh: 三体问题 · 一条四维曲线的三个影子
title.en: The Three-Body Problem · Three Shadows of One 4-D Curve

desc.zh: 三个质点、一条牛顿定律，没有解析解。真实运动发生在 ℝ³ 里；加上时间，本体是 (x, y, z, t) 里的一条四维曲线——而引擎只有三根世界轴，所以每次只能看它的一个三维影子。工具给出四种喂法：纯空间 x·y·z 是它真正在做的事，另外三张把时间接上，得到 x·y·t、y·z·t、x·z·t 三条时间辫。先把预设留在图 8 编舞——一条你事先知道形状的干净闭合曲线——把轨道平面拧到一般姿态，三张影子会长得毫不相干；读数区实时对比「真实最近接近距离」与各投影下「看起来的」距离，后者总是更小，这就是影子欺骗性的量化证据。图 8 那一页还说明另一件事：三体不是总是混乱，是几乎总是——精确的周期解确实存在，但它像刀锋上的平衡，给一体 10⁻⁸ 的扰动，几十个周期后就找不回来了。最后一页把混沌的放大器指出来：近距离遭遇——出射方向对入射参数极度敏感，分离曲线的每一次跳变下面都对应一次遭遇。全程只做单向推演，用辛的 velocity-Verlet，能量与角动量漂移常驻读数。
desc.en: Three point masses, one law of gravitation, and no closed-form solution. The real motion happens in ℝ³; add time and the object itself is a curve in (x, y, z, t) — four dimensions — while the engine has only three world axes, so you can only ever see one of its three-dimensional shadows. The tool offers four feeds: pure space x·y·z is what it is really doing, and three more splice in time to give the braids x·y·t, y·z·t and x·z·t. Leave the preset on the figure-8 choreography first — a clean closed curve whose shape you already know — tilt its orbital plane to a generic attitude, and the three shadows come out looking like unrelated curves. The readout continuously compares the true closest-approach distance against the apparent one in the current projection, and the apparent one is always smaller: quantified evidence that shadows lie. The figure-8 tab makes a second point: the three-body problem is not always chaotic, only almost always — exact periodic solutions do exist, but they balance on a knife edge, and a 10⁻⁸ nudge to one body loses the choreography within tens of periods. The last tab names the amplifier: close encounters, where the outgoing direction is exquisitely sensitive to the incoming parameters — every jump in the separation curve sits above one. Everything runs forward only, on symplectic velocity-Verlet, with energy and angular-momentum drift always on screen.

title.zh: 让倒立摆站起来 · 反馈与 PID
title.en: Standing a Pendulum Up · Feedback and PID

desc.zh: 倒立摆的开环极点是 ±√(g/L)，右半平面那个正极点就是「必倒」的数学。第一页把两个相同的摆并排：开环那根不是「没控制」，是「控制了但不看结果」——运行中偷偷把摆长改掉 30%，开环立刻散架，闭环只轻微抖一下就稳住，这就是「反馈让你不必知道精确模型」的实证。第二页是全控制论最好的一个隐喻：P 看现在、I 看过去、D 看未来，误差的三个时态被一个控制器全占了；三项贡献分色沿时间轴流出并在原点叠成合力，逐项开关就能把每条教训单独看清——只有 P 时常值扰动留下看得见的稳态误差，加 I 归零但超调变大（相位滞后的代价），加 D 阻尼上来、而一打开测量噪声，翠绿的 D 项当场被撕碎。第三页讲失稳的真正根源：把增益推到发散不稀奇，稀奇的是加 20 毫秒延迟，临界增益就塌了近五倍——力不是太大，是来得太晚，纠正到达时误差已经反号，纠正于是变成了驱动。第四页收尾：角速度测不到就别去微分噪声，用模型去估计。
desc.en: The inverted pendulum's open-loop poles are ±√(g/L), and that positive one in the right half-plane is the mathematics of "it must fall". Tab one puts two identical rods side by side: the open-loop copy is not uncontrolled, it is controlled without looking at the result — change the rod length by 30% mid-run and it falls apart at once while the closed-loop copy barely twitches. That is the proof, not the slogan, that feedback frees you from needing an exact model. Tab two is the best metaphor in all of control: P watches the present, I the past, D the future — one controller covering all three tenses of the error. The three contributions stream out in their own colours and stack into the total at the origin, and switching them one at a time isolates each lesson: with P alone a constant disturbance leaves a visible steady-state error; adding I drives it to zero at the price of overshoot, which is what phase lag costs; adding D brings damping, and the moment you switch on measurement noise the emerald D term is visibly shredded. Tab three names the real cause of instability: pushing the gain until it diverges is unremarkable, but adding 20 ms of delay collapses the critical gain nearly fivefold — the force is not too strong, it arrives too late, and by the time the correction lands the error has changed sign, so the correction becomes the drive. Tab four closes the loop: if you cannot measure the rate, do not differentiate noise — estimate it with a model.

title.zh: 从根轨迹到守恒律 · 反馈的深层结构
title.en: From Root Locus to Conservation · The Deep Structure of Feedback

desc.zh: 把复平面放在水平面上、把增益 K 竖起来当第三根轴，闭环极点就不再是一张静止的图，而是一束在三维中迁移的曲线。沿增益轴俯视，你看到的正是教科书那张根轨迹；转过来，才发现它一直是三维的。倒立摆在这里是反的——曲线从右半平面出发，增益够大才穿过虚轴进入左半平面，穿越点恰好是 K = mgL：比例增益必须先顶过重力矩。第二页讲内模原理：常值扰动要靠积分器消掉，而正弦扰动无论怎么调 PID 都压不干净，除非在回路里装一个该频率的谐振器——误差谱上那根尖峰当场被打出一个洞。要消掉什么，回路里就得装什么的模型；I 项不是玄学，它是常值信号的模型。第三页是控制论最漂亮的守恒律：灵敏度的对数在整个频率轴上积分是一个常数，你在某个频段把误差压下去，它必然在别处鼓起来。倒立摆有一个右半平面极点 p，于是这个积分等于 π·p 而不是零——它的不稳定，给你的水床压了一个不可讨价还价的下限。第四页换成小车-摆：一个作动器要管两件事，只稳角度则小车匀速漂走，想管住位置就必须先把摆推向反方向。必要多样性在这里不是哲学命题，是你亲眼看见小车漂走。
desc.en: Lay the complex plane flat and stand the gain K up as a third axis, and the closed-loop poles stop being a static picture and become a bundle of curves migrating through three dimensions. Look down the gain axis and you see exactly the textbook root locus; rotate away and you discover it was three-dimensional all along. The inverted pendulum is the inverted case — the branch starts in the right half-plane and only crosses into the left once the gain is large enough, and the crossing sits exactly at K = mgL: proportional gain must first overcome the gravitational torque. Tab two is the internal model principle. A constant disturbance falls to an integrator, but a sinusoidal one cannot be cleaned up by any amount of PID tuning until a resonator at that frequency is placed in the loop — whereupon the spike in the error spectrum is punched into a hole. To reject something, the loop must contain a model of it; the I term is not folklore, it is the model of a constant. Tab three is the most beautiful conservation law in control: the integral of log sensitivity over all frequency is fixed, so pushing error down in one band forces it up in another. The pendulum has one right-half-plane pole p, so that integral equals π·p rather than zero — its instability presses an unnegotiable floor into your waterbed. Tab four switches to the cart-pole: one actuator, two things to regulate. Stabilise the angle alone and the cart drifts steadily away; command the position and you must first drive the pole the wrong way. Requisite variety here is not a philosophical claim — it is a cart you watch slide off.

title.zh: 火箭：会自己变的倒立摆 · 推力矢量控制
title.en: The Rocket: An Inverted Pendulum That Changes · Thrust Vector Control

desc.zh: 火箭就是倒立摆——推力接在下面，重心在上面。它多出来的是三样东西：被控对象在飞行中自己变，扰动通道变多，作动器有限。燃料烧掉，质量、转动惯量、重心位置全在漂，于是等效控制增益 T·ℓ(t)/J(t) 一路走高（本工具默认参数下涨到两倍以上）——你起飞时调好的那组增益，只在飞行的某一段是对的，这正是真实火箭必须做增益调度的原因，末页把定增益与调度增益放在同一阵风里并排飞给你看。这也是一个可以动手的沙盒：设定风速与阵风、推力、燃料、重心与压心偏移、PID 三项、采样率、喷管限幅与限速，然后按重置就是再发射一次。采样率一低，零阶保持的台阶在第二页肉眼可见地变粗，相位裕度被它一口口吃掉——那条「力不是太大是来得太晚」的教训，这次是你亲手撞的墙。关键是每次坠毁都可诊断而不是随机翻车：黑匣子按优先级判出首要死因（采样过慢、高增益撞饱和、缺增益调度、积分饱和、作动器太慢），并给出识别它的证据。风用带种子的伪随机数，同种子两次发射逐位一致，于是一次漂亮的或惨烈的飞行可以存下来、发给别人、逐帧复看。
desc.en: A rocket is an inverted pendulum — thrust at the bottom, centre of mass above. What it adds is three things: the plant changes during flight, there are more disturbance channels, and the actuator is limited. As propellant drains, mass, inertia and centre of mass all drift, so the effective control gain T·ℓ(t)/J(t) climbs steadily — more than doubling over a flight at the default settings. The gains you tuned at liftoff are right for only part of the flight, which is precisely why real launch vehicles schedule them, and the last tab flies fixed gains against scheduled gains through the very same gusts. It is also a sandbox to play in: set wind and gusts, thrust, propellant, the centre-of-mass and centre-of-pressure offsets, the three PID terms, the sampling rate and the nozzle's deflection and slew limits, then press reset to launch again. Lower the sampling rate and the zero-order-hold staircase visibly coarsens on the second tab while phase margin is eaten away — the lesson that force is not too strong but too late, this time as a wall you walk into yourself. The point is that every crash is diagnosable rather than random: the black box ranks the primary cause — sampling too slow, high gain hitting saturation, missing gain scheduling, integral windup, actuator too slow — and shows the evidence that identifies it. Wind comes from a seeded generator, so two launches with the same seed are bit-identical, and a beautiful or catastrophic flight can be saved, shared and replayed frame by frame.

title.zh: 陀螺仪的原理 · 角动量与姿态控制
title.en: How a Gyroscope Works · Angular Momentum & Attitude Control

desc.zh: 转子上每一点的速度都在变，但 L = Iω 这一根矢量始终指着自旋轴，方向由右手定则给出——第一页把轴摆起来，两个分量此消彼长，模长却是一条笔直的横线，这条线就是后面全部故事的本钱。第二页把陀螺装进三层万向环：载体的六个自由度里，三个转动被三层环一一读了出来，三个平动它一个字也读不到，这正是「姿态基准」的定义；把俯仰推到 ±90°，外环枢轴与转子轴当场重合，万向节死锁就在眼前，链条乘出来恰好是单位阵，不是画上去的效果。第三页解的是定点对称陀螺真正的欧拉—拉格朗日方程：重力给的是力矩而不是拉力，dL = τ dt 垂直于 L，于是陀螺不倒、只是绕圈，俯视看去 τ 永远切于轴尖画出的那条带尖点的圆；自旋调慢，章动小圈立刻长大。后两页把这根矢量交给航天器：反作用轮页里星体与轮子的角动量是一对精确的镜像，总和是一条平线，拉开外扰力矩它就变成斜坡，轮子被一路推到上限、控制当场失效——这就是真实卫星必须定期卸载动量的原因；末页是控制力矩陀螺，轮子转速不变，只把它的指向整体搬过去，τ = −Ω × Lw，一台小小的框架电机因此能给出反作用轮想都不敢想的力矩，国际空间站靠的正是这个。
desc.en: Every point on the rotor keeps changing velocity, yet one vector L = Iω always points along the spin axis, its direction fixed by the right-hand rule. The first tab nods that axis: the two components trade off while the magnitude stays a dead-straight line, and that line is the capital every later story trades on. The second tab mounts the gyro in three gimbals: of the carrier's six degrees of freedom the three rotations are read off one ring at a time, while the three translations register nothing at all — which is exactly what an attitude reference means. Push pitch to ±90° and the outer pivot lines up with the rotor axis: gimbal lock, and the gimbal chain multiplies out to the identity matrix rather than merely looking like it. The third tab integrates the real Euler–Lagrange equations of a symmetric top about a fixed point: gravity supplies a torque, not a pull, dL = τ dt is perpendicular to L, and so the top circles instead of falling — seen from above, τ is forever tangent to the cusped circle the tip draws, and slowing the spin blows those nutation loops wide open. The last two tabs hand that vector to a spacecraft. On the reaction-wheel tab the body and wheel momenta are exact mirror images and their sum is flat; open the external torque and the sum becomes a ramp, the wheel is driven to its limit and control dies on the spot — which is why real satellites must dump momentum. The final tab is the control moment gyro: wheel speed never changes, only its direction is carried around, τ = −Ω × Lw, so a tiny gimbal motor delivers torque a reaction wheel could never dream of. This is what holds the ISS.

title.zh: 最优与估计 · LQR 与卡尔曼
title.en: Optimal Control and Estimation · LQR and Kalman

desc.zh: 前三个控制论工具里，你一直在调控制器：调增益、看极点往哪走、量裕度还剩多少。这一个把它翻过来——你不再设计控制器，只说明「你想要什么」和「你相信谁」，控制器是算出来的。LQR 回答怎么动：把复平面放平、代价比 q/r 竖起来当第三根轴，闭环极点随你的偏好迁移，这是根轨迹那一页的刻意呼应，只是第三根轴从「你手动扫的增益」换成了「你声明的代价」；同屏跑一个手调增益并积同一个代价函数，手调那条要么更慢要么更费力，总有一项输——「最优」二字因此可以核对，而不是形容词。卡尔曼回答你以为自己在哪：增益是两个不确定度的加权，测量噪声大它就选择相信模型，过程噪声大它就选择相信测量；这正是前一个工具里手调观测器的最优版本。协方差那一页把估计的不确定性画成一只呼吸的椭圆：预测让它沿动力学拉伸长大，测量让它沿被测方向收缩；而只测角度却能估出角速度，靠的是动力学的耦合把确定性传播过去——把耦合切断，椭圆在角速度方向就再也不收缩了。最后一页给出分离原理：闭环极点恰是 LQR 极点与卡尔曼极点的并集，两件事真的可以分开设计，这是定理不是巧合，读数逐个数字可核对。但它也给出代价：状态反馈的 LQR 有 60° 的保证相位裕度，一旦串上观测器，保证就没了——最优不等于稳健，这是定理的边界，不是实现的缺陷。
desc.en: In the first three cybernetics tools you were always tuning the controller: adjusting gains, watching poles move, measuring how much margin was left. This one turns that around — you no longer design the controller, you only state what you want and whom you trust, and the controller is computed. LQR answers how to move: lay the complex plane flat and stand the cost ratio q/r up as a third axis, and the closed-loop poles migrate with your preference. It is a deliberate echo of the root-locus tab, with the third axis changed from a gain you swept by hand to a cost you declared. A hand-tuned gain runs alongside and both are scored by the same cost integral; the hand-tuned one is always either slower or more expensive, so "optimal" becomes something you can check rather than an adjective. The Kalman filter answers where you think you are: its gain is a weighting of two uncertainties, trusting the model when measurement noise is large and the sensor when process noise is large — the computed version of the hand-placed observer from the previous tool. The covariance tab draws estimation uncertainty as a breathing ellipse: prediction stretches and grows it along the dynamics, measurement contracts it along what is measured. Measuring only the angle still pins down the rate, because coupling propagates certainty from one to the other — cut the coupling and contraction in the rate direction stops entirely. The last tab gives the separation principle: the closed-loop poles are exactly the LQR poles together with the Kalman poles, so the two designs really do decouple, a theorem rather than a coincidence, checkable digit by digit in the readout. And it gives the price: LQR state feedback carries a guaranteed 60° phase margin, and wiring an observer in front of it destroys that guarantee. Optimal is not the same as robust — that is the boundary of the theorem, not a flaw in the implementation.

desc.zh: 先把「弯」变成一个数：一条曲线在每一点都有一个最贴合它的圆，曲率就是这个圆的倒半径。让点沿椭圆跑一圈，密切圆时大时小，圆心画出一条星形线 —— 曲线越平，圆心跑得越疯；而不管椭圆多扁，累积转角 ∮κ ds 总是精确落在 2π，这是 Gauss–Bonnet 的第一次预告。到了曲面上，一个点不再只有一个曲率：法平面绕法线转一圈，截出的曲线曲率一直在变，可它并不自由 —— 欧拉公式说它只由最大最小两个值决定，κ_n(θ) = κ₁cos²θ + κ₂sin²θ，而且这两个方向必然垂直，读数的周期是 π 而不是 2π。把这两个数相乘就是高斯曲率 K = κ₁κ₂，相加取半是平均曲率。这里出现第一个反直觉的事实：把 κ₂ 调到 0，曲面成了抛物柱面 —— 它在空间里明明是弯的，K 却是 0；沿母线看过去整张曲面叠成一条抛物线，弯只发生在一个方向上。弯 ≠ 曲率。最后一页是绝妙定理本身。K 的定义完全是外在的 —— 它问的是曲面怎样嵌在空间里。可屏幕上同时给出第二个数：一只只有卷尺、永远出不了曲面的蚂蚁，量出以自己为心、内蕴半径 r 的圆的周长 C，发现它比 2πr 短，再从亏损反解出 K。两个数字一路吻合。于是把纸卷成筒：外在的 κ₁ = 1/R 从 0 一路涨上去，K 却死死钉在 0.00 不动 —— 卷纸没有拉伸,蚂蚁量到的一切都没变。而球冠摊平时会缺一个楔形口子，因为它的 K 不是 0，无论怎么弯都不可能变成 0。这就是为什么纸能卷成筒，却永远包不住橘子。
desc.en: First turn "bending" into a number: at every point a curve has a best-fitting circle, and curvature is that circle's reciprocal radius. Run a point once around an ellipse and the osculating circle swells and shrinks while its centre traces an astroid — the flatter the curve, the more wildly the centre races. Yet however squashed the ellipse, the accumulated turning ∮κ ds lands exactly on 2π, a first trailer for Gauss–Bonnet. On a surface a point no longer has just one curvature: rotate a normal plane about the normal and the sectional curvature keeps changing — but it is not free. Euler's formula pins it to two extreme values, κ_n(θ) = κ₁cos²θ + κ₂sin²θ, those two directions are necessarily perpendicular, and the readout's period is π, not 2π. Multiply the two and you get the Gaussian curvature K = κ₁κ₂; average them and you get the mean curvature. Here comes the first counterintuitive fact: dial κ₂ to zero and the surface becomes a parabolic cylinder — visibly bent in space, yet K = 0. Sight down its ruling and the whole surface stacks into a single parabola: the bending happens in one direction only. Bent is not the same as curved. The last tab is the theorem itself. K is defined extrinsically — it asks how the surface sits in space. But a second number appears beside it: an ant with nothing but a tape measure, that can never leave the surface, walks out an intrinsic radius r, measures the circumference C of the resulting circle, finds it shorter than 2πr, and solves the deficit back for K. The two numbers agree all the way. So roll a sheet of paper into a tube: the extrinsic κ₁ = 1/R climbs from zero while K stays pinned at 0.00 — no stretching happened, so nothing the ant can measure changed. A spherical cap laid flat, by contrast, leaves a wedge-shaped gap, because its K is not zero and no amount of bending can make it so. That is why paper rolls into a tube but never wraps an orange.
